dataStream.name: tenants
dataStream.sql: SELECT "name" AS "tenant", "status" AS "health", CASE "tenantType" WHEN 'client' THEN 'Site' WHEN 'multiClient' THEN 'Multi-site' WHEN 'corporateIt' THEN 'Corporate IT' ELSE COALESCE("tenantType", 'Tenant') END || ' · ' || COALESCE("status[Expanded].rawState", 'Unknown') AS "detail" FROM "dataset"

config.description: This tenant's Auvik subscription state and whether it is a site or a multi-site
config.title: Site Status

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onlineStatus" = 'success') AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS "online", CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onlineStatus" = 'success') AS VARCHAR) || ' of ' || CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) || ' online' AS "label" FROM "dataset"

config.description: Share of this tenant's devices that Auvik currently reports as online
config.title: Devices Online

config.description: Alerts raised in the last 30 days that are still open
config.title: Open Alerts

config.description: Average monitored devices and total device-days Auvik counted for this tenant over the last 30 days
config.title: Billable Usage

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT COALESCE("tenantName", 'Unknown site') AS "site", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onlineStatus" = 'error') > 0 THEN 'error' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onlineStatus" = 'warning') > 0 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END AS "health", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onlineStatus" = 'success') AS "online", COUNT(*) AS "devices" FROM "dataset" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "devices" DESC

config.description: Each site in this tenant by its Auvik domain, coloured by its worst device status. A single site shows itself
config.title: Sites

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", CASE "onlineStatus[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'online' THEN 'Online' WHEN 'offline' THEN 'Offline' WHEN 'unreachable' THEN 'Unreachable' WHEN 'lowerLayerDown' THEN 'Link down' WHEN 'dormant' THEN 'Dormant' WHEN 'testing' THEN 'Testing' WHEN 'notPresent' THEN 'Not present' ELSE 'Status unknown' END AS "status" FROM "dataset"), r AS (SELECT "type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "type") AS rn FROM d GROUP BY "type") SELECT CASE WHEN r.rn <= 7 THEN d."type" ELSE 'Other types' END AS "type", d."status", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM d JOIN r ON r."type" = d."type" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "devices" DESC

config.description: How each type of device at this site is faring: every type flows into the status its devices are in, so trouble shows up as red or amber on the right
config.title: Health by Device Type

config.description: Alerts raised each day over the last 30 days, by severity
config.title: Alert Trend

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", COALESCE("vendorName", 'Unknown vendor') AS "vendor", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM "dataset" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "devices" DESC

config.description: This tenant's devices grouped by device type, then vendor
config.title: What's on the Network

config.description: This tenant's devices with the highest average CPU utilization
config.title: Busiest CPUs

config.description: This tenant's devices with the highest average memory utilization
config.title: Memory Pressure

config.description: This tenant's devices moving the most traffic, average Mbps in and out
config.title: Top Talkers

dataStream.name: interfaces
dataStream.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT "deviceName" AS "device", CASE WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'online' THEN 'Connected' WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'adminDown' THEN 'Disabled' ELSE 'Not connected' END AS "state" FROM "dataset" WHERE "deviceName" IS NOT NULL AND "deviceName" NOT LIKE 'Object not found%'), top AS (SELECT "device" FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT "device", "state", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "ports" FROM s WHERE "device" IN (SELECT "device" FROM top) GROUP BY "device", "state" ORDER BY CASE "state" WHEN 'Connected' THEN 0 WHEN 'Not connected' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, "device"

config.description: Connected, unconnected and disabled ports on this tenant's devices with the most interfaces
config.title: Ports in Use

config.description: Alerts raised in the last 30 days that are still open, most severe first. Click a row to open it in Auvik
config.title: Alerts to Action

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT "name" AS "device", CASE WHEN "onlineStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'lowerLayerDown' THEN 'Lower layer down' WHEN "onlineStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'notPresent' THEN 'Not present' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE("onlineStatus[Expanded].rawState", 'unknown'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(COALESCE("onlineStatus[Expanded].rawState", 'unknown'), 2) END AS "state", "onlineStatus" AS "health", CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", "vendorName" AS "vendor", "makeModel" AS "model", "ipAddresses" AS "ips", "softwareVersion" AS "software", "lastSeenTime" AS "lastSeen", "tenantName" AS "site", "link" FROM "dataset" ORDER BY CASE "onlineStatus" WHEN 'error' THEN 0 WHEN 'warning' THEN 1 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, LOWER("name")

config.description: Every device Auvik has discovered in this tenant, offline devices first. Click a row to open it in Auvik
config.title: Device Inventory

config.description: Hardware warranty and service contract cover for this tenant's devices, expired cover first
config.title: Warranty Coverage

config.description: Where each device sits in its vendor's end-of-life cycle. Red means that milestone has passed
config.title: Vendor Lifecycle

dataStream.name: networks
dataStream.sql: SELECT "type", "scan", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "networks" FROM (SELECT CASE "networkType" WHEN 'routed' THEN 'Routed' WHEN 'vlan' THEN 'VLAN' WHEN 'wifi' THEN 'Wi-Fi' WHEN 'layer2' THEN 'Layer 2' WHEN 'loopback' THEN 'Loopback' WHEN 'network' THEN 'Network' WHEN 'internet' THEN 'Internet' ELSE COALESCE("networkType", 'Other') END AS "type", CASE "scanStatus" WHEN 'success' THEN 'Scanning' WHEN 'error' THEN 'Scan failed' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Pending' WHEN 'unmonitored' THEN 'Not scanned' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "scan", CASE "scanStatus" WHEN 'success' THEN 0 WHEN 'warning' THEN 1 WHEN 'error' THEN 2 WHEN 'unmonitored' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS "rank" FROM "dataset") GROUP BY "type", "scan", "rank" ORDER BY "rank", "networks" DESC

config.description: This tenant's networks by type, and whether Auvik is scanning them for devices
config.title: Network Discovery

config.description: Who opened a remote session to a device in this tenant over the last 30 days, newest first
config.title: Remote Access
